_about: Data for ND Outfit Builder (same engine as the Character Builder, see character_builder.json for the shared fields). Generated by tools/make_outfit_data.py; edit this file directly to tune wording. Item (option) fields: noun (what it is called in a sentence), tag (Danbooru tag), styles (styles it suits; random uses it only when no style is chosen, or one of its styles is), only (female / male; random skips it for the other wearer), explicit (needs the Explicit switch), plural (no article, 'are'), covers (parts of the body it hides, see covers in character_builder.json), length (the Length parameter applies), mutes (e.g. 'top.*': a one-piece switches Top off), material_in_noun (the noun already says the material), metal / color (which accessory parameter colors it), barefoot. Parameter fields: custom (a Custom chip with a text field), filter_by (random is filtered by the chosen styles), explicit (the whole parameter needs the Explicit switch), edit.ops (Add / Replace / Remove in Edit mode). State fields: text (predicate after 'is'), tag, edit (Edit sentence with {pos} and {noun}), uncover (covers the state removes from the item: a list or 'all'), explicit. Length fields: covers_add. Sleeve fields: arms_covers. Exposure fields: drops (slots or 'part.param' left out), text, tag, edit. Part field slot: noun, add / replace / remove / change (Edit sentences), kind (garment, wear, accessory).

zones.hint: Hats, crowns, hair accessories and other things worn on the head.

zones.label: Top
zones.hint: Shirts, tops and corsets worn on the upper body.

zones.label: Outerwear
zones.hint: Jackets, coats, capes and armor worn over the top.

zones.label: One-piece
zones.hint: Dresses, jumpsuits and robes. A one-piece switches Top and Bottom off.

zones.label: Underwear
zones.hint: Bras, panties and lingerie, together or separately.

zones.label: Accessories
zones.hint: Jewelry, glasses, belts, bags and other extras.
